reason: A visual interface plugin for DSH Web that adds a Galgame-style conversation view with themed presentation, dialogue playback, history, and question or approval controls; the README states it is a pure visual layer that does not persist sessions or interfere with the agent loop.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 添加 Galgame 风格的对话界面，以立绘、对话框、思考气泡、历史回顾及提问审批选项呈现会话内容。
summaries.en: Adds a Galgame-style conversation view to DSH Web with portraits, dialogue playback, thought bubbles, history, and question or approval controls.

capabilities: Adds a Galgame-style conversation interface view
Reads conversation snapshots to render filtered dialogue and status
Renders portraits, thought bubbles, dialogue paging, history, and settings controls
Displays question and approval interactions and can send user steer input
Serves bundled static portrait assets through a host route
